preconditions.description: Number of cities is within the specified range.
Number of roads is less than the number of cities.
Number of queries is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in roads)
preconditions.description: Roads are between valid cities and are not self-loops.

preconditions.expression: all(query[0] in [1, 2] and 1 <= query[1] <= n and (query[0] == 2 implies 1 <= query[2] <= n)) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Queries are valid and city indices are within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) and answer >= 0 for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == max_path_length(region(city)) for answer, city in zip(answers, cities_with_queries))
postconditions.description: Each answer corresponds to the length of the longest path in the region containing the queried city.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= city <= n for city in cities_in_regions)
invariants.description: All cities are within the specified range.
Each region contains at least one city.
